title: AMRIE Interpretation Configuration
description: Schema for the AMRIE antimicrobial resistance interpretation engine configuration file. All properties are optional; omitted properties use their documented defaults.

$schema.description: URI reference to this JSON Schema.

RoundHalfDilutions.description: When true, ETest half-dilution MIC values (e.g., 1.5) are rounded to the nearest standard doubling dilution before breakpoint lookup. Matches EUCAST and CLSI ETest rounding guidance.

IncludeInterpretationComments.description: When true, interpretation codes include modifier characters: '!' for expert-rule overrides, '*' for intrinsic resistance, '?' for out-of-range measurements.

UseIntrinsicResistanceRules.description: When true, the engine applies species-level intrinsic resistance rules (from ExpectedResistancePhenotypes.txt) before breakpoint lookup. Intrinsically resistant combinations are reported as 'R' regardless of the measured value.

oneOf.description: Array of expert rule codes to enable. An empty array disables all expert rules. A non-empty array enables only the listed rules.

EnabledExpertInterpretationRules.description: Expert interpretation rule codes to activate. null or omitted = all default rules active. Empty array [] = all expert rules disabled. Non-empty array = only the listed rules are active.

GuidelineYear.description: Publication year of the breakpoint guideline edition to use (e.g., 2026). The engine selects the most recent breakpoints with YEAR <= GuidelineYear. 0 or omitted resolves to the current bundled breakpoint revision year at runtime.

oneOf.description: Ordered preference list for BREAKPOINT_TYPE selection. The engine uses the first type in this list that has an applicable breakpoint.

PrioritizedBreakpointTypes.description: Ordered preference list for breakpoint type selection. null or omitted = all types eligible with no preference. Empty array [] is normalized to null. Recognized values: 'Human', 'Animal', 'ECOFF'.

examples: Infections originating from the urinary tract

oneOf.description: Ordered preference list for site-of-infection breakpoint selection. Sites not listed are appended automatically in the default engine order. Sites in DisabledSitesOfInfection are excluded.

PrioritizedSitesOfInfection.description: Ordered preference list for site-of-infection breakpoint selection. null or empty array = default engine order applies. Sites in DisabledSitesOfInfection are excluded from the effective order.

oneOf.description: Site-of-infection values to exclude from breakpoint lookup. These sites will not appear in the effective PrioritizedSitesOfInfection list.

DisabledSitesOfInfection.description: Sites of infection to exclude entirely from breakpoint selection. null or empty array = no sites disabled.

HorizontalAntibioticResults.description: Output layout for FILE mode. true = wide/horizontal: one row per isolate with <FIELD>_INTERP columns. false = tall/vertical: one row per antibiotic measurement with ANTIBIOTIC_CODE, ANTIBIOTIC_MEASUREMENT, ANTIBIOTIC_INTERPRETATION columns.

oneOf.description: Relative path from AppContext.BaseDirectory to a user-defined breakpoints file in Breakpoints.txt tab-delimited schema format.

UserDefinedBreakpointsFile.description: Path (relative to the AMRIE executable directory) to a user-defined breakpoints file. The file must use the same tab-delimited schema as the built-in Breakpoints.txt. User-defined entries take precedence over built-in entries for matching organism/drug/guideline/year/method/site combinations.
